title: The Presupposition Problem in Representation Genesis
abstract: arXiv:2603.21745v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are the first systems to achieve high cognitive performance without clearly undergoing representation genesis: the transition from a non-representing physical system to one whose states guide behavior in a content-sensitive way. Prior cognitive systems had already made this transition before we could examine it, and philosophy of mind treated genesis as a background condition rather than an explanatory target. LLMs provide a case that does not clearly involve this transition, making the genesis question newly urgent: if genesis did not occur, which cognitive capacities are affected, and why? We currently lack the conceptual resources to answer this. The reason, this paper argues, is structural. Major frameworks in philosophy of mind, including the Language of Thought hypothesis, teleosemantics, predictive processing, enactivism, and genetic phenomenology, share a common feature when applied to the genesis

translated_title: 表征发生中的预设问题
translated_abstract: 大语言模型是首批在没有明显经历“表征发生”的情况下实现高认知表现的系统。所谓表征发生，是指从非表征的物理系统转变为一个其状态能以内容敏感方式引导行为的系统的过程。以往的认知系统在我们能够考察这一转变之前就已经完成了它，而心灵哲学一直将“发生”视为背景条件而非解释目标。大语言模型提供了一个不明显涉及这一转变的案例，这使得发生问题重新变得紧迫：如果发生并未发生，哪些认知能力会受到影响，为什么？我们目前缺乏回答这一问题的概念资源。本文认为，其原因在于结构性的。心灵哲学的主要框架——包括思想语言假说、目的语义学、预测加工、生成主义和发生现象学——在应用于发生问题时都具有一个共同特征
tldr: 本文提出“表征发生预设问题”，指出大语言模型未经历从非表征系统到表征系统的发生转变，而思想语言假说、目的语义学、预测加工、生成主义和发生现象学等心灵哲学主要框架均以表征发生为前提，因而现有理论缺乏解释LLM在缺失发生时认知能力状况的概念资源。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "presupposition problem in representation genesis," arguing that LLMs did not clearly undergo the transition from non-representing to representing systems, and that major frameworks in philosophy of mind—from Language of Thought to enactivism—all presuppose this genesis, leaving us without the conceptual resources to explain which cognitive capacities are affected when genesis does not occur.
